# League of Legends Match Data Report

This report summarizes the latest match data for all tracked summoners.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
data <- read_csv('data/all_games_new.csv')
```

## Games per Summoner

```{r games-per-summoner}
data %>%
  count(summonerName) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(summonerName, n), y = n, fill = summonerName)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Games per Summoner", x = "Summoner", y = "Number of Games") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Win Rate by Summoner

```{r winrate-by-summoner}
data %>%
  group_by(summonerName) %>%
  summarise(games = n(), wins = sum(win, na.rm=TRUE), winrate = wins/games) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(summonerName, winrate), y = winrate, fill = summonerName)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Win Rate by Summoner", x = "Summoner", y = "Win Rate") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Top Champions Played

```{r top-champions}
data %>%
  count(championName, sort = TRUE) %>%
  top_n(10, n) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(championName, n), y = n, fill = championName)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Champions Played", x = "Champion", y = "Games Played") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## KDA Distribution

```{r kda-distribution}
data %>%
  mutate(kda = (kills + assists) / pmax(1, deaths)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = kda)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#69b3a2", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "KDA Distribution", x = "KDA", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```
